# Adornment

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("Adornment")`
- **Abstract**: it cannot be created; other classes inherit from it

The base class of the shapes drawn on a part: plain colors, not lit and not exposed with the scene, drawn where the part is. They are visual only: nothing collides with them, and raycasts do not hit them.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Adornee` | `(BasePart | Model)?` | — | read/write | The part or model the shape is drawn on. With nil, its parent is used if the parent is one of those. A shape with neither is not drawn. |
| `Color3` | `Color3` | `Color3.new(0.05, 0.41, 0.68)` | read/write | The color the shape is drawn in, as it was set, by day and by night. |
| `Transparency` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How transparent the shape is, from 0 (solid) to 1 (not drawn). |
| `Visible` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the shape is drawn. |
